title: TMC split news highlights: 'MPs alone cannot merge with another party', Abhishek says after meeting with Speaker
description: TMC split news highlights: Abhishek Banerjee, Kalyan Banerjee and Mahua Moitra are among the TMC leaders part of Team Mamata Banerjee who held a meeting with Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla over the proposal by a rebel faction of 20 MPs to merge with a party called NCPI and support the NDA.
